We need to get template. Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria with target molecule? Need target SMILES. The target molecule is likely the protected alcohol from previous step. Which one? The list includes three possible product SMILES (first element of each pair). They are similar: C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO etc. That's a complex molecule with O[Si] group. So target is that protected molecule. Choose one. Probably any works. Use first SMILES as target. Let's store.


We'll call search_template_catalog_by_criteria with that SMILES and functional_groups_broken=["alcohol"], functional_groups_formed maybe ["silyl_ether"] but not sure if available. Let's just use broken alcohol.
